purpose: Per-skill lookup into persisted historical package-security evidence for the 44 first-party skills, with current exact package-tree binding.
read_me: Each record includes the original baseline and candidate source paths and exact package tree comparisons. Baseline state is transferable only for identical tree; newer/different candidate scan passes are not. A matching historical PASSED is not newly executed security testing and does not imply behavioral validation, licensing clearance, or host authorization.

records.caution: Historical scan for exact matching package tree; not a fresh scan, behavior test, license clearance or unattended install approval. Candidate pass is NOT transferable if its tree differs.
